name: rdClose

comment: Installs the function Render_Present calls to show the back buffer Original name sputRender_SetPageFlipCallback (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the only unpaired writer of sputRender_pPageFlipFunc, same body; grimlib_SetPageFlipCallback jumps to it); was Render_SetFlipCallback.

comment:
Lua opcodes: IsFullscreenMoviePlaying, IsMoviePlaying
also registered as IsFullscreenMoviePlaying Original name sputLua_IsMoviePlayingL (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (pushes 1 or nil by sputSmush_MoviePlaying)); was Lua_IsMoviePlaying.

name: Main_Startup
comment: grimdemo.c: whole-engine startup: service tables, registry/config, window + 256-colour check, display enumeration, resource system, Lua engine lib registration, iMUSE. Original name Main_Startup (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the same start-up sequence (developer registry key compared with "TRUE" and "pl", rdStartup / rdOpen, the window message hook, stdDisplay_Startup, the shutdown / palette / page-flip / debug-toggle callbacks, grimlib_FindResources)); was Grim_Init.

name: grimlib_SetShutdownCallback
comment: Original name grimlib_SetShutdownCallback (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the first callback set in Main_Startup, with grimdemo_PleaseShutdown on both sides, same body); was Engine_SetIdleCallback.

comment: Opens debug.log / resource.log and installs the debug-print callbacks into the service table Original name grimdemo_EnableDebugging (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the debug-toggle callback of Main_Startup; sets the same five host-service print slots (+4, +8, +0xc, +0x10, +0x14)); was DebugLog_Init.

name: grimdemo_StatusPrint
comment: g_MainServices.pPrintf: snprintf into a 0x400 buffer, prints to the debugger/window and appends to debug.log. Original name grimdemo_StatusPrint (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service slot +4 grimdemo_EnableDebugging sets); was DebugLog_Printf.

name: grimdemo_MessagePrint
comment: g_MainServices.pPrintf2: like DebugLog_Printf with its own 0x400 buffer. Original name grimdemo_MessagePrint (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service slot +8 grimdemo_EnableDebugging sets); was DebugLog_Printf2.

name: grimdemo_WarningPrint
comment: g_MainServices.pWarning: formats into a 0x400 buffer, prints and appends to debug.log. Original name grimdemo_WarningPrint (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service slot +0xc grimdemo_EnableDebugging sets); was DebugLog_Warning.

name: grimdemo_ErrorPrint
comment: g_MainServices.pError: formats into a 0x400 buffer, prints and appends to debug.log. Original name grimdemo_ErrorPrint (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service slot +0x10 grimdemo_EnableDebugging sets); was DebugLog_Error.

name: grimdemo_DebugPrint
comment: g_MainServices.pDebug: formats into a 0x400 buffer, prints and appends to debug.log. Original name grimdemo_DebugPrint (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service slot +0x14 grimdemo_EnableDebugging sets); was DebugLog_Debug.
